access: Assistant web.open exposed readable English text for three Wowhead guides. Not a raw DOM, installed extension or Chrome Translator API capture.

pages.observation: Power Word: Shield prevents cast time pushback. The phrase describes damage-induced delay of a cast, not a spell interrupt or knockback.
Power Word: Shield prevents bare pushback. This heldout is deliberately excluded from the narrower cast time pushback rule.
Cast time pushback appears with Searing/Magma Totem offensive pressure and Chain Heal/Healing Wave vulnerability; separate from interrupts.

glossaryAdditions.cast time pushback: retard d’incantation causé par les dégâts

crossPageFix.scope: EN->FR player glossary; generic pushback, channeling, knockback and interrupt remain unmodified
